results.title: About Shopify App Store ads
results.snippet: While all ad types use CPC pricing, the bidding process and costs differ for each ad type. When you create a homepage or category ad, you specify the bid amount that you would pay to have your ad shown. When a merchant visits the homepage or the selected category, an auction takes place where advertisers who want to show their ad compete by submitting their bid. The ads from the winning advertisers in each auction are shown in a ranked order.
